name: Retiree / Interest Rate Earner Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be at least 55 years old.

Requires guaranteed annual income of at least AFL 50,000 (about US$27,900) from pension, annuity, or investment yields, paid from an authorised bank in the Netherlands, an OECD country, a UNASUR member, a CARICOM member, or an EU partnership country.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.

Requires at least AFL 100,000 (about US$55,900) per year from a bank-balance/investment asset, or an equivalent AFL 100,000 in annual rental income from real estate in an authorised country/region (Netherlands, OECD, UNASUR, CARICOM, EU partnership countries).

evidence_required.document: Bank statements showing average yearly income

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, renewable annually under the same conditions

sources.title: DIMAS, Government of Aruba -- Retiree / Interest Rate Earner: two income-based grounds (guaranteed income, age 55+, AFL 50,000/yr; non-guaranteed assets/rental, age 18+, AFL 100,000/yr), authorised-country bank list, 1-year renewable permit, no paid work permitted

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Aruba's initial build. Two OR-groups folded into one file since both lead to the identical Retiree/Interest Rate Earner permit with the same outcome, differing only in age threshold and the income test. No paid work is allowed on this permit -- a separate work permit is required, unlike some countries' retiree/passive-income routes in this dataset that permit limited local work. USD conversions in blocker_text are approximate (AFL is pegged near 1.79 per USD) and included only as an orientation aid -- the binding figures are the AFL amounts stated on the source page. leads_to_pr/pr_after_months (120 months) reflects the Indefinite Period Residence route's stated 120-month/10-year threshold (see aw_indefinite_residence.json), since annual renewal of this permit is one of the ways that clock accrues.
